problem: A successful managed literal append gets an actual exact full SSI before its matched same-owner Reset and physical release. Reset erases confirmed SSI and may erase the actual consumed-press ledger. Stock IBus deduplicates the unchanged receipt. Native Backspace then loses its inert predecessor even though the shortened SSI is genuine. Presentation-only deferral does not solve these Reset transitions.
sequence: existing manual request refused after predecessor loss

options.name: A: retain consumed release pairing and one already confirmed full observation across a separately proved first held managed-effect Reset
options.limits: Consumed key routing does not grant text authority. Whole observation carry is separately bounded by exact actual effect, original observation revision, held effect identity, first matched Reset and current owner revalidation.

decision: Use option A with explicit Matched/Refused/Cleanup receipt from the existing observation callback. The live post-Reset token must match pinned owner/focus/lease; queued authenticated callbacks may share the latest reducer token. Extend the existing successful managed_commit_snapshot_floor into a named effect record with keycode, focus, lease, layout, epoch, observation floor and one-use eligibility, written after successful CommitText only. Carry original confirmed whole actual observation at unchanged revision only for the first matched held singleton effect and strict pinned current token. Spend eligibility on first matched Reset even without SSI; refused/cleanup/foreign callbacks cannot spend it. Never reconstruct SSI or upgrade completeness.

Word-lineage, Reset revocation, layout and the700ms observation deadline do not make an already consumed press unhandled. shares_input_activation compares existing connection/owner/activation metadata only and grants no text authority. Revalidate after output awaits: strict token for observation, same live actual activation for release pairing. Direct unauthenticated soft-reset helper stays conservative. Expired-Reset fixture changes only release assertion; expired observation/Space work stays inadmissible.
